_purpose: This file gives the B6 (earnings/hr) benchmark verdict a number to score against.
It is NOT the production rate card. The coordinator's rewards.rate_card config
is not configured on Pearl as of 2026-06-29 — billing currently emits zero credits.
When real settlement pricing lands, scenario 10 should point at the operator-curated
manifest instead of this file (or this file's contents should be lifted into one).
_calibration: Rates calibrated against the v0.1 B6 thresholds (≥$0.30/hr bare-min, ≥$1.00/hr target
per provider) and observed sustained TPS of ~14 tok/s on M4 Air (Qwen3-32B-4bit).
So 7B-class completion @ $0.02/1k is the 'just clears target' anchor.
Smaller models priced proportionally lower; 32B-class higher.
_revisit_when: Fleet sustained TPS shifts materially (>2× current 14 tok/s) — rates can drop.
Real production rate card lands in coordinator.yaml rewards.rate_card.
Network adds tier-2 attested providers with higher-end hw (M4 Max, M2 Ultra).
